purpose: Compare the current original-STS KSP aerodynamic model at a hypothetical KSC 38 km witness state with the retained entry-shadow drag estimate, and sample nearby Mach/AoA/sideslip/bank conditions.

qualification.note: Every returned wrench is a counterfactual KSP simulation. It is not measured flight force, a shadow-gate pass, or landing qualification.

provenance.apiUt: The shadow trace UT is passed explicitly. The KSC site position and local orientation are rotated from current paused UT using the live body's measured angular velocity so they refer to the same inertial epoch.
provenance.positionOrigin: Configuration site latitude/longitude (KSC Runway 09 center) at the shadow trace altitude; the shadow point is about 4.55 km from the runway center, so this is a nearby uniform-atmosphere location proxy.
provenance.velocityOrigin: Requested local-body airflow for the selected AoA and sideslip plus the planet's local rotational velocity at the target inertial position.
provenance.angularVelocityPolicy: Zero hypothetical vessel angular velocity to isolate static aerodynamic force and moment; no damping moment is included.
provenance.surfaceStatePolicy: Use the currently loaded original-STS part and control-surface state. No control, action group, throttle, RCS, SAS, save, position, velocity, orientation, or time setters are called.

gridDefinition.nominalMachPolicy: Mach slices use the closest recorded shadow-witness speed of sound (V/M, 1.50 s from the trace point). The trace-speed slice is exact input TAS; the API accepts velocity rather than Mach, so nominal Mach is provenance metadata, not a separate API output.
gridDefinition.dynamicPressureScaling: The trace q is scaled by TAS squared at fixed density only for comparison metadata; KSP computes each wrench internally from the hypothetical position, velocity and explicit UT.

matchedWitnessComparison.note: The comparison uses current original-STS parts, a simulated KSC runway-center position, zero angular velocity, checkpoint-profile mass, and the shadow trace's q-scaled density proxy. It is a model discrepancy diagnostic, not measured flight force or qualification.

loadedMassAssessment.massUsedForDragAcceleration: checkpoint profile mass; the paused loaded vessel reports a placeholder mass, so no angular-acceleration inference is made from the simulated torque.
loadedMassAssessment.torqueLimitation: The wrench torque is returned about the current loaded vessel center of mass. Because the paused loaded mass differs from the settled checkpoint profile, torque is retained as descriptive output only and is not used to infer angular acceleration or calibrate control coupling.
